name: The Dead Air Anchor
ongoing_text: Media Industry yields 1 Influencer instead of 2. Rebuilt locations that pay Influencers pay 1 fewer.

name: The Gridlock
ongoing_text: City Hall's Liaison Desk and Mayor's Office are closed. Rebuilding at Permits costs 1 extra Regulatory Contact.

name: The Wrecking Crew
ongoing_text: Rebuilt locations pay no owner benefits.

name: The Leak
ongoing_text: The Press Room is closed and Spin cards cannot be played.

name: The Embezzler
ongoing_text: Each player collects devotion income from at most 2 devoted cards.

name: The Escalator
ongoing_text: Every crisis costs 2 extra Analysts to resolve.
